5535-a-thorny-path-volume-06.title: A Thorny Path Volume 06
5535-a-thorny-path-volume-06.creator: Georg Ebers
5535-a-thorny-path-volume-06.description: A book by Georg Ebers. Philostratus saw that her appearance had been judiciously cared for; but Caesar's long silence, of which he knew the reason, began to cause him some uneasiness: for, though pain sometimes softened the despot's mood, it more often prompted him to revenge himself, as it were, for his own sufferings, by brutal attacks on the comfort and happiness of others.

arxiv-2105-05668.title: Variable stepsize SDIMSIMs for ordinary differential equations
arxiv-2105-05668.creator: A. Jalilian, A. Abdi, G. Hojjati
arxiv-2105-05668.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by A. Jalilian, A. Abdi, G. Hojjati. Second derivative general linear methods (SGLMs) have been already implemented in a variable stepsize environment using Nordsieck technique. In this paper, we introduce variable stepsize SGLMs directly on nonuniform grid. By deriving the order conditions of the proposed methods of order p p and stage order q = p q=p , some explicit examples of these methods up to order four are given.

arxiv-2108-13918.title: Particle properties in the early universe from the contraction of the SM gauge group
arxiv-2108-13918.description: Abstract The properties of elementary particles and their interactions at different stages of the evolution of the Universe, starting with the Planck energy 10 19 10^{19} GeV, are presented. We assume that the Standard Model gauge group becomes simpler as the temperature of the universe increases.

arxiv-2205-05227.title: Towards Improved Zero-shot Voice Conversion with Conditional DSVAE
arxiv-2205-05227.creator: Jiachen Lian, Chunlei Zhang, Gopala Krishna Anumanchipalli, Dong Yu
arxiv-2205-05227.description: Abstract Disentangling content and speaking style information is essential for zero-shot non-parallel voice conversion (VC). Our previous study investigated a novel framework with disentangled sequential variational autoencoder (DSVAE) as the backbone for information decomposition. We have demonstrated that simultaneous disentangling content embedding and speaker embedding from one utterance is feasible for zero-shot VC.

arxiv-2409-00121.title: BELT-2: Bootstrapping EEG-to-Language representation alignment for multi-task brain decoding
arxiv-2409-00121.creator: Jinzhao Zhou, Yiqun Duan, Fred Chang, Thomas Do, Yu-Kai Wang, Chin-Teng Lin
arxiv-2409-00121.description: Abstract The remarkable success of large language models (LLMs) across various multi-modality applications is well established. However, integrating large language models with humans, or brain dynamics, remains relatively unexplored. In this paper, we introduce BELT-2, a pioneering multi-task model designed to enhance both encoding and decoding performance from EEG signals.

arxiv-2411-02825.title: Revisiting holographic codes with fractal-like boundary erasures
arxiv-2411-02825.creator: Abhik Bhattacharjee, Joydeep Naskar
arxiv-2411-02825.description: Abstract In this paper we investigate the code properties of holographic fractal geometries initiated in [ 1 ] . We study reconstruction wedges in A ​ d ​ S 3 / C ​ F ​ T 2 AdS_{3}/CFT_{2} for black hole backgrounds, which are in qualitative agreement with the vacuum-AdS approximation using generalized entanglement entropy in [ 2 ] .

arxiv-2508-05131.title: Plans for acceptance sampling by attributes when observations are destructive
arxiv-2508-05131.creator: Hugalf Bernburg, Katy Klauenberg
arxiv-2508-05131.description: Abstract The international standard ISO 2859-2 provides plans for acceptance sampling by attributes, that ensure a defined quality level in isolated lots using the hypergeometric distribution. In destructive testing, the sample itself is damaged or changed such that the quality of an entire lot is less relevant than the quality of the lot that remains after removing the sample.

pmc-10550188.title: Prescription of anti-influenza drugs in Japan, 2014–2020: A retrospective study using open data from the national claims database
pmc-10550188.creator: Akahito Sako, Yoshiaki Gu, Yoshinori Masui, Kensuke Yoshimura, Hidekatsu Yanai, Norio Ohmagari, Jingjing Qian, Jingjing Qian, Jingjing Qian
pmc-10550188.description: BackgroundBoth physicians and patients are proactive towards managing seasonal influenza in Japan and six drugs are approved. Although many countries have national influenza surveillance systems, data on nationwide prescription practices of anti-influenza drugs are lacking. Therefore, we aimed to clarify the status of anti-influenza drug use in Japan by analyzing real-world data.

pmc-11356817.title: Effects of Physical Exercise on the Microbiota in Irritable Bowel Syndrome
pmc-11356817.creator: Chunpeng Li, Jianmin Li, Qiaorui Zhou, Can Wang, Jiahui Hu, Chang Liu
pmc-11356817.description: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a prevalent functional gastrointestinal disorder characterized by abdominal pain, bloating, diarrhea, and constipation. Recent studies have underscored the significant role of the gut microbiota in the pathogenesis of IBS. Physical exercise, as a non-pharmacological intervention, has been proposed to alleviate IBS symptoms by modulating the gut microbiota.

pmc-11561527.title: Tuberculous Pericarditis in an Immunocompromised Patient: A Case Report
pmc-11561527.creator: Nawaf Alotaibi, Faisal Almutawa, Alwaleed Alhazzaa, Ihab Suliman
pmc-11561527.description: This case report details the presentation, diagnostic process, and management of tuberculous pericarditis (TBP) in a 43-year-old male with a history of chronic severe pericarditis, right-sided heart failure, and rheumatoid arthritis. The patient exhibited symptoms of chest pain and dyspnea and showed signs of ascites and mild lower limb edema.

pmc-11632254.title: Investigating the causal links between inflammatory cytokines and scoliosis through bidirectional Mendelian randomization analysis
pmc-11632254.creator: Muradil Mardan, Mardan Mamat, Parhat Yasin, Xiaoyu Cai, Huoliang Zheng, Qingyin Xu, Shaokuan Song, Bo Li, Hao Cai, Pengbo Chen, Zeyu Lu, Shahna Omar, Shengdan Jiang, Leisheng Jiang, Xin‐feng Zheng
pmc-11632254.description: BackgroundScoliosis, characterized by a lateral curvature of the spine, affects millions globally. The role of inflammatory cytokines in the pathogenesis of scoliosis is increasingly acknowledged, yet their causal relationships remain poorly defined.AimsThis study aims to explore the genetic‐level causal relationships between inflammatory cytokines and scoliosis utilizing bidirectional Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis.

pmc-12773309.title: Abstract 001: Microvascular reperfusion during endovascular therapy: the balance of supply and demand
pmc-12773309.creator: Christopher G Favilla, Rodrigo M Forti, Wesley B Baker, Sarah Carter, Scott E Kasner, Arjun G Yodh, Stephanie Cummings, David Kung, Jan‐Karl Burkhardt, Bryan A Pukenas, Visish M Srinivasan, John A Detre
pmc-12773309.description: IntroductionEndovascular therapy (EVT) has revolutionized acute stroke treatment, but large vessel recanalization does not always result in tissue‐level reperfusion. Cerebral blood flow (CBF) is not routinely monitored during EVT. Here we aimed to leverage diffuse correlation spectroscopy (DCS), a novel transcranial optical imaging technique, to assess the relationship between microvascular CBF and post‐EVT outcomes.

pmc-13083856.title: The microbiome of interstitial cystitis revealed by 2bRAD-M
pmc-13083856.creator: Ying Gan, Jingjun Zhang, Kaifeng Yao, Rui Jiang, Zheng Li, Yang Yang
pmc-13083856.description: Interstitial cystitis/bladder pain syndrome (IC/BPS) is a chronic, female-prone, multifactorial bladder disorder characterized by symptoms such as suprapubic pain, urinary urgency, frequency, and pelvic discomfort, often exacerbated by bladder filling and associated with urothelial dysfunction and inflammation, while the etiology of IC/BPS remains largely unknown.

pmc-13091293.title: Literature review: Disparities in depression care for racial and ethnic minoritized youth☆
pmc-13091293.creator: Vanessa C D’Souza, Monica J Taylor-Desir, Andrés J Pumariega
pmc-13091293.description: ObjectiveThe aims of this paper are to review the current literature on racial and ethnic disparities in depression care for children and adolescents and identify strategies to provide culturally responsive care that eliminates disparities in depression care for youth. Our tertiary aim is to highlight gaps in the current literature.

pmc-13334305.title: The effects of feeding diets with ensiled maize grain on the production efficiency and meat characteristics of broiler ducks
pmc-13334305.creator: Bartosz Bigorowski, Sebastian Wlaźlak, Izabela Narloch, Szymon Różański
pmc-13334305.description: IntroductionAlternative methods of duck feeding can be good solutions for reducing production costs on small farms. Ensiled corn grain is a good source of energy that can be used in the rearing of broiler ducks. This research investigated productivity effects and meat quality parameters in experimental broiler ducks provided this material as feed portions.

pmc-13342964.title: Complicated thrombosed popliteal venous aneurysm in an adolescent managed by aneurysmorrhaphy with a literature review
pmc-13342964.creator: Meriam Mesrati, Hela Ben Jemiaa, Nawel Hchaichi, Zied Ben Ayed, Imed Frikha
pmc-13342964.description: Popliteal venous aneurysm is a rare vascular entity associated with a high risk of thromboembolic complications. We report the case of a 16-year-old girl presenting with acute left lower-limb pain and swelling. Magnetic resonance imaging revealed a large thrombosed popliteal venous aneurysm (60 × 40 × 34 mm).

pmc-13439840.title: Barriers to healthcare and justice for sexual and gender-based violence survivors in Sierra Leone: A gender-integrated socio-ecological analysis
pmc-13439840.creator: Rose McKeon Olson, Josephine Ndanemah, Daniel Nguyen, Ranu Dhillon, Daniel Kettor, Anthony Sam, Lydia E. Pace
pmc-13439840.description: BackgroundSexual and gender-based violence (SGBV) is a threat to women and girls' health and justice globally, and is widely prevalent in Sierra Leone. This study identifies key barriers to high-quality healthcare and justice for SGBV survivors in Sierra Leone using a gender-integrated socio-ecological model.MethodsIn this qualitative study, purposive sampling was performed with maximum variation by sector and region.

pmc-13501664.title: Bridging the gap: neuroinflammation and the dawn of precision medicine in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
pmc-13501664.creator: Lu Tang, Dongsheng Fan
pmc-13501664.description: Neuroinflammation is no longer a secondary feature of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but rather a disease-modifying process that actively shapes the motor neuron vulnerability from the earliest stages of pathology. Central and peripheral immune cells, including microglia, astrocytes, and infiltrating T lymphocytes, adopt context-dependent states that can be neuroprotective or neurotoxic depending on disease stage and genetic background.
